publicReleaseNotes:
Pencil 0.3.0 adds grounded analysis of completed text answers, actions taken from an analysis's recommendation, a Typeform move-in audited against Typeform's documented export format, and a respondent notice whenever answers can reach an AI provider.

Analysis is optional and off until you configure a provider. It groups a revision's completed text answers into ranked themes; Pencil recomputes every count, checks every quote character for character against the stored answer, withholds themes below the disclosure threshold, and fails a run with nothing shown when the provider's answer does not check out. Only the selected answers and response IDs are sent. While a provider is configured, the Before you share note on every form tells respondents that their written answers may be sent to the AI service the business chose, and that their name, email address and network address are never sent. Analysis was checked against a scripted local provider, not against a live model.

Invitation and reminder retries now stay inside their one-hour budget and six attempts even when a queue wakes late, and closing the current revision by target or deadline no longer stops invitations pinned to an older revision.

/health reports the deployment that answered from rer deploy's own record; PENCIL_BUILD_ID is retired. Pencil runs the published rer 0.2.0 CLI.

0.2.0's migration 0019 could not be applied by Cloudflare D1, so 0.2.0 could not be hosted there. 0.3.0 rewrites 0019 in a form D1 parses, with the same checks, and 0034 brings a database that applied 0.2.0's text to the same schema. Export before upgrading from 0.2.0 and apply 0027 through 0034 in order; every one is additive.

Exactly 3 clauses remain deferred: ANLY-009 (builder assistance), NOTIFY-001 and NOTIFY-003. The importers were checked with documented-format synthetic files only. Hosted capacity beyond the measured ceiling and live delivery are not claimed.
